content_of_post_to_comment: I know sometimes the “you’ve got your hands full” line at the grocery store is a whole thing, but positive story: A mid-20s farm guy in boots and a cowboy hat climbing out of a ranch truck told me “excuse me ma’am, but I just want to say how strong and powerful you are with those little ones” when I was wrangling my kids at Aldi at 4 pm yesterday, and ngl, it was great. Also great was my kids calling me strong and powerful the rest of the day.
comment: There’s something interesting about how strangers often notice the visible chaos of parenting before the invisible strength behind it. Maybe the shift is less about needing fewer hands full and more about changing what we choose to see.
